title: PREFIXES & SUFFIXES
notes:
✓ Prefix → a group of letters added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning.

✓ happy → unhappy
✓ possible → impossible

✓ Suffix → a group of letters added to the end of a word to change its meaning, word class, or form.

✓ teach → teacher
✓ happy → happiness

✓ Prefix = before the root word.
✓ Suffix = after the root word.

title: COMMON PREFIXES: MEANING
notes:
✓ un- → not / opposite
✓ happy → unhappy

✓ in- / im- / il- / ir- → not
✓ correct → incorrect
✓ possible → impossible
✓ legal → illegal
✓ regular → irregular

✓ dis- → not / opposite / reverse
✓ agree → disagree
✓ honest → dishonest

✓ mis- → wrongly / incorrectly
✓ understand → misunderstand
✓ behave → misbehave

✓ re- → again
✓ write → rewrite
✓ build → rebuild

✓ pre- → before
✓ history → prehistory
✓ paid → prepaid

✓ post- → after
✓ war → postwar

✓ anti- → against
✓ social → antisocial

✓ auto- → self
✓ biography → autobiography

title: PREFIXES: NUMBER & DEGREE
notes:
✓ bi- → two
✓ bicycle → two wheels

✓ tri- → three
✓ triangle → three angles

✓ multi- → many
✓ multicultural → many cultures

✓ semi- → half / partly
✓ semicircle → half a circle

✓ over- → too much / above
✓ overeat → eat too much

✓ under- → too little / below
✓ underpaid → paid too little

✓ super- → above / very great
✓ supernatural → beyond the natural

✓ sub- → under / below
✓ submarine → vessel operating under water

title: COMMON SUFFIXES: NOUNS
notes:
✓ Many suffixes form nouns from verbs, adjectives, or other nouns.

✓ -er / -or → person who does something
✓ teach → teacher
✓ act → actor

✓ -ness → state or quality
✓ kind → kindness
✓ happy → happiness

✓ -ment → result/process
✓ develop → development
✓ move → movement

✓ -tion / -sion → action or process
✓ inform → information
✓ decide → decision

✓ -ity → state or quality
✓ active → activity
✓ possible → possibility

✓ -ship → state, position, or relationship
✓ friend → friendship
✓ leader → leadership

✓ -ist → person connected with a field/activity
✓ art → artist
✓ science → scientist

title: COMMON SUFFIXES: ADJECTIVES
notes:
✓ These suffixes commonly form adjectives.

✓ -ful → full of
✓ care → careful
✓ beauty → beautiful

✓ -less → without
✓ care → careless
✓ hope → hopeless

✓ -ous → characterized by
✓ danger → dangerous
✓ fame → famous

✓ -able / -ible → capable of / can be
✓ read → readable
✓ access → accessible

✓ -al → relating to
✓ nation → national
✓ culture → cultural

✓ -ive → having a quality or tendency
✓ act → active
✓ create → creative

✓ -y → characterized by
✓ rain → rainy
✓ health → healthy

title: COMMON SUFFIXES: VERBS
notes:
✓ Some suffixes form verbs from nouns or adjectives.

✓ -ize / -ise → make or become
✓ modern → modernize
✓ organ → organize

✓ -ify → make or become
✓ simple → simplify
✓ beauty → beautify

✓ -en → make/become
✓ short → shorten
✓ strength → strengthen

✓ These suffixes often change a noun or adjective into a verb.

title: COMMON SUFFIXES: ADVERBS
notes:
✓ The suffix -ly commonly forms adverbs from adjectives.

✓ quick → quickly
✓ careful → carefully
✓ slow → slowly
✓ happy → happily

✓ Adverbs formed with -ly often describe how an action happens.

✓ She spoke quietly.
✓ He worked carefully.

title: WORD FORMATION
notes:
✓ Prefixes usually change meaning without changing the basic word class.

✓ happy → unhappy
✓ possible → impossible

✓ Suffixes often change the word class.

✓ happy (adjective) → happiness (noun)
✓ teach (verb) → teacher (noun)
✓ care (noun/verb) → careful (adjective)
✓ quick (adjective) → quickly (adverb)

✓ When completing word-formation questions, identify the required word class first.

title: SPELLING CHANGES
notes:
✓ Adding a suffix can sometimes change the spelling of the root word.

✓ happy → happiness
✓ easy → easily
✓ beauty → beautiful
✓ create → creation
✓ decide → decision

✓ Do not simply add the suffix without checking the correct spelling.

✓ Common change → final y may change to i before some suffixes.
✓ happy → happiness
✓ happy → happily

title: EXAM GUIDE
notes:
◆ 1. PREFIX → added to the beginning.
✓ unhappy

◆ 2. SUFFIX → added to the end.
✓ happiness

◆ 3. Negative meaning → un-, in-, im-, il-, ir-, dis-.

◆ 4. Wrong action → mis-.

◆ 5. Again → re-.

◆ 6. Before → pre-.

◆ 7. After → post-.

◆ 8. Against → anti-.

◆ 9. Person who does an action → -er / -or.

◆ 10. State or quality → -ness / -ity.

◆ 11. Action/process → -tion / -sion / -ment.

◆ 12. Full of → -ful.

◆ 13. Without → -less.

◆ 14. Can be → -able / -ible.

◆ 15. Adverb → commonly -ly.

✓ Golden rule → For word-formation questions, first identify what the word must mean and what part of speech is required, then choose the appropriate prefix or suffix.
